history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration establish an integrated tool for roster management to improve the efficiency of managing the roster of electoral experts.
history.administration_response: The Department of Operational Support has worked with the Business Transformation and Accountability Division in the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, as well as the Security Council Affairs Division and the Electoral Assistance Division, both in the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs, to develop the business requirements for building a talent pool functionality in Inspira so as to allow for the better management and refreshing of related consultant rosters. It is tentatively planned to roll out this functionality by the end of the first quarter of 2022, and it will subsequently be available to all clients in the United Nations Secretariat by the end of the second quarter of 2022.
history.board_assessment: Given that the talent pool functionality in Inspira to allow better management and refreshing of related consultant rosters is under development, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration establish an integrated tool for roster management to improve the efficiency of managing the roster of electoral experts.
history.administration_response: The Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs is part of a working group led by the Human Resources Services Division of the Department of Operational Support to develop a talent pool management tool for consultants and individual contractors. The Office of Information and Communications Technology built a talent pool functionality in Inspira to allow for the better management and refreshing of related consultant pools, including electoral experts. The functionality has already been rolled out to three client entities.
history.board_assessment: Given that the talent pool function in Inspira has been activated, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
